DON_QUIXOTE_RELIC_DON_QUIXOTE_BLOOD_INST:
Heal 15% of the damage your attacks deal.
Every 325 points of [red]Total Bloodfeast Spent[/red], gain 1 [gold]Where Happy Smiles Bloom Like Flowers[/gold].
After the second turn begins, if [red]Bloodfeast[/red] is 0, gain 1 [gold]Weak[/gold] and 1 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
The instinct of the bloodfiends is older than reason.
DON_QUIXOTE_RELIC_DON_QUIXOTE_BLOOD_ELDE:
Heal 20% of the damage your attacks deal.
Whenever you play an Attack, gain 2 [red]Bloodfeast[/red].
Every 325 points of [red]Total Bloodfeast Spent[/red], gain 1 upgraded [gold]Where Happy Smiles Bloom Like Flowers[/gold].
After the second turn begins, if [red]Bloodfeast[/red] is 0, gain 1 [gold]Weak[/gold] and 1 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
An elder's instinct no longer asks reason for permission.
DON_QUIXOTE_RELIC_DON_QUIXOTE_KNIGHT_OF_:
At the start of combat, apply [gold]Corruption[/gold] equal to its counter (shown under the relic).
Right-click a card in your hand: spend 30 [red]Bloodfeast[/red] to Enchant it with [gold]Indestructible Card[/gold] and gain 30 [red]Total Bloodfeast Spent[/red].
Every charge brings the knight closer to instinct.
DON_QUIXOTE_RELIC_DON_QUIXOTE_BLOOD_CRYS: At the end of your turn, heal for 0.01 x (total enemy [red]Bleed[/red] x total enemy [red]Bleed[/red] Layers).
Even clotted blood can flow again.
DON_QUIXOTE_RELIC_DON_QUIXOTE_DULCINEA.d: At the start of combat, gain 15 [gold]Blood-Woven Thorns[/gold].
DON_QUIXOTE_RELIC_DON_QUIXOTE_DULCINEA.f: She never left the manor, and never left her heart.
DON_QUIXOTE_RELIC_DON_QUIXOTE_GULLINBURS: At the start of combat, gain 50 [red]Bloodfeast[/red].
The best wine is kept for the finest knight.
DON_QUIXOTE_RELIC_DON_QUIXOTE_NIKOLINA.f: She counts every drop of blood like family fortune.
DON_QUIXOTE_RELIC_DON_QUIXOTE_MOON_FLIGH: The first time each Corrupted card is played, it costs 1 less for the rest of the combat.
If any horse could fly to the moon, it would be mine.
DON_QUIXOTE_RELIC_DON_QUIXOTE_FAREWELL.d: At the start of combat, gain 1 [gold]Duel Glory[/gold].
DON_QUIXOTE_RELIC_DON_QUIXOTE_FAREWELL.f: From here on, there is no road back.
DON_QUIXOTE_RELIC_DON_QUIXOTE_PROOF_OF_V: After killing an enemy with 10 or more [red]Bleed[/red], gain 2 [gold]Strength[/gold] next turn.

DON_QUIXOTE_RELIC_DON_QUIXOTE_MIRAKA.des: Whenever you apply [red]Bleed[/red], apply 1 additional Potency (unaffected by [gold]Returning Bloodlust[/gold]).
DON_QUIXOTE_RELIC_DON_QUIXOTE_MIRAKA.fla: Her blood burns hotter than fire and cuts truer than any blade.
DON_QUIXOTE_RELIC_DON_QUIXOTE_HARD_BLOOD: The weight of the halberd is paid for in hardened blood.
DON_QUIXOTE_RELIC_DON_QUIXOTE_TORN_BLOOD: The first 3 times an enemy's [red]Bleed[/red] triggers each turn, trigger it 1 additional time.
